english.text: If you wish to speak with many people, you ought to learn Esperanto. Why this language? Because it is both beautiful and stimulates our study. An international language is of great moment because there are so many people in the various countries of the world. And besides, Esperanto is not only useful but easy to learn. If you speak Esperanto you can travel in many countries. Come and learn it!

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 tung4 hou2 do1 jan4 gong2 je5，nei5 jing1 goi1 hok6 sai3 gaai3 jyu5，jan1 wai6 keoi5 ge3 leng3 jau6 ci3 gik1 ngo5 dei6 ge3 hok6 zaap6，jan1 wai6 sai3 gaai3 gok3 gwok3 dou1 jau5 hou2 do1 jan4。 ji4 ce2，sai3 gaai3 jyu5 m4 daan1 zi2 jau5 jung6，zung6 hou2 ji6 hok6，jyu4 gwo2 nei5 sik1 dak1 maai4 gong2 sai3 gaai3 jyu5，nei5 ho2 ji5 heoi3 hou2 do1 gwok3 gaa1 leoi5 hang4。
text: 如果你想同好多人講嘢，你應該學世界語，因為佢嘅靚又刺激我哋嘅學習，因為世界各國都有好多人。 而且，世界語唔單止有用，仲好易學，如果你識得埋講世界語，你可以去好多國家旅行。

english.text: Once there were two women who were best friends, yet they were different: one was as beautiful as the new day but poor as a church mouse, while the other was as unsightly as the night but immeasurably rich. Now it came about that a fellow moved into the land; straightaway he was greedy for the wealth of the unsightly one, but he preferred to be adorned with the beauty by his side.

jyutping: cang4 ging1 jau5 loeng5 go3 neoi5 jan2 hai6 zeoi3 hou2 ge3 pang4 jau5，daan6 hai6 keoi5 dei6 m4 tung4：jat1 go3 hou2 ci5 san1 jat6 zi2 gam3 leng3，daan6 hai6 hou2 ci5 gaau3 tong4 lou5 syu2 gam3 kung4，ji4 ling6 jat1 go3 zau6 hou2 ci5 je6 maan5 gam3 cau2 lau6，daan6 hai6 jau6 jau5 cin2 dou3 mou4 bei2 ji4 zik1 hak1 bun1 jap6 go2 go3 dei6 fong1，keoi5 zau6 taam1 zo2 go3 cau2 joeng2 ge3 jan2 ge3 coi4 fu3，daan6 hai6 keoi5 ning4 jyun6 bei2 di1 leng3 ge3 jan2 zong1 sik1 hai2 keoi5 san1 bin1。
text: 曾經有兩個女人係最好嘅朋友，但係佢哋唔同：一個好似新日子咁靚，但係好似教堂老鼠咁窮，而另一個就好似夜晚咁醜陋，但係又有錢到無比而即刻搬入嗰個地方，佢就貪咗個醜樣嘅人嘅財富，但係佢寧願畀啲靚嘅人裝飾喺佢身邊。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Some people base reality in their local sphere. Maybe, most people do not travel enough, I mention to Bratislav. A bit aghast becomes Bratislav, of Croatian ancestry. I tell him about the Daoist notion that one's own garden or local neighbourhood may be a microcosm that reflects macrocosmic reality. All the learning from all the travelling one can do may lie right here locally. A snail on the sidewalk may have a "doppelganger" (Bratislav's conceptual word) in the macrocosm.

jyutping: jau5 di1 jan2 zoeng1 jin6 sat6 gin3 laap6 hai2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 bun2 dei6 ling5 wik6。ho2 nang4，daai6 bou6 fan6 jan2 dou1 m4 gau3 heoi3 leoi5 hang4，ngo5 tung4 bou3 laai1 dik6 si1 laai1 fu1 tai4 gwo3，jau5 di1 ging1 ngaa6 wui5 bin3 sing4 hak1 lo4 dei6 aa3 hyut3 tung2 ge3 bou3 laai1 dik6 si1 laai1 fu1，ngo5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 dou6 gaau3 ge3 gun1 nim6，zik1 hai6 zi6 gei2 ge3 faa1 jyun2 waak6 ze2 dong1 dei6 ge3 se5 keoi1 ho2 nang4 hai6 jat1 go3 faan2 jing2 wang4 gun1 jin6 sat6 ge3 mei4 gun1 sai3 gaai3。so2 jau5 leoi5 hang4 so2 hok6 dou3 ge3 je5，dou1 ho2 nang4 hai2 dong1 dei6 ge3 ni1 dou6。jan4 hang4 dou6 soeng6 ge3 wo1 ngau4 ho2 nang4 hai2 wang4 gun1 sai3 gaai3 jap6 min6 jau5 go3「fan1 san1」（bou3 laai1 dik6 si1 laai1 fu1 ge3 koi3 nim6 ci4）。
text: 有啲人將現實建立喺佢哋嘅本地領域。可能，大部分人都唔夠去旅行，我同布拉迪斯拉夫提過，有啲驚訝會變成克羅地亞血統嘅布拉迪斯拉夫，我同佢講道教嘅觀念，即係自己嘅花園或者當地嘅社區可能係一個反映宏觀現實嘅微觀世界。所有旅行所學到嘅嘢，都可能喺當地嘅呢度。人行道上嘅蝸牛可能喺宏觀世界入面有個「分身」（布拉迪斯拉夫嘅概念詞）。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The U.S. Pacific Islands region includes more than 2,000 islands spanning millions of square miles of ocean. Rising air and ocean temperatures, shifting rainfall patterns, changing frequencies and intensities of storms and drought, decreasing streamflows, rising sea levels, and changing ocean chemistry will threaten the sustainability of globally important and diverse ecosystems as well as local communities, livelihoods, and cultures.

jyutping: mei5 gwok3 taai3 ping4 joeng4 kwan4 dou2 dei6 keoi1 baau1 kut3 ciu1 gwo3 2，000 go3 dou2 zeoi6，kwaa1 jyut6 gei2 baak3 maan6 ping4 fong1 jing1 lei5 ge3 hoi2 joeng4。hung1 hei3 tung4 hoi2 joeng4 wan1 dou6 soeng6 sing1、gong3 jyu5 mou4 sik1 ge3 bin3 faa3、fung1 bou6 tung4 hon5 zoi1 ge3 pan4 leot2 tung4 koeng4 dou6 ge3 bin3 faa3、kai1 lau4 ge3 gaam2 siu2、hoi2 ping4 min6 ge3 soeng6 sing1，tung4 maai4 hoi2 joeng4 faa3 hok6 ge3 bin3 faa3，dou1 wui5 wai1 hip3 cyun4 kau4 zung6 jiu3 tung4 do1 jyun4 faa3 ge3 sang1 taai3 hai6 tung2，tung4 maai4 dong1 dei6 se5 keoi1、sang1 gai3 tung4 man4 faa3 ge3 ho2 ci4 zuk6 sing3。
text: 美國太平洋群島地區包括超過2，000個島嶼，跨越幾百萬平方英里嘅海洋。空氣同海洋溫度上升、降雨模式嘅變化、風暴同旱災嘅頻率同強度嘅變化、溪流嘅減少、海平面嘅上升，同埋海洋化學嘅變化，都會威脅全球重要同多元化嘅生態系統，同埋當地社區、生計同文化嘅可持續性。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "I don't understand the sentence saying because she wasn't home, she couldn't be reached." "It has to be understood in its historical context, where there used to be fixed home telephones and not everyone could be reached anywhere at any time with their phone." "Do you mean you could only use your phone at home?" "Or in a phone booth."

jyutping: 「ngo5 m4 ming4 go2 geoi3 syut3 waa6 waa6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 m4 hai2 uk1 kei2，so2 ji5 lyun4 lok3 m4 dou3 keoi5。」 「ni1 go3 bit1 seoi1 hai2 keoi5 ge3 lik6 si2 bui3 ging2 jap6 min6 heoi3 lei5 gaai2，ji5 cin4 jau5 gu3 ding6 ge3 gaa1 geoi1 din6 waa2，ji4 m4 hai6 so2 jau5 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 si4 jung6 sau2 gei1 heoi3 dou3 jam6 ho4 dei6 fong1。」 「nei5 hai6 mai6 zi2 nei5 zi2 ho2 ji5 hai2 uk1 kei2 jung6 nei5 bou6 din6 waa2？」 「waak6 ze2 hai2 din6 waa2 ting4 jap6 min6。」
text: 「我唔明嗰句說話話因為佢唔喺屋企，所以聯絡唔到佢。」 「呢個必須喺佢嘅歷史背景入面去理解，以前有固定嘅家居電話，而唔係所有人都可以隨時用手機去到任何地方。」 「你係咪指你只可以喺屋企用你部電話？」 「或者喺電話亭入面。」
